usedFor: Streams and uploads in api.video, such as “Live Stream Ended”, lead to files being shared or copied in Google Drive.

bestTemplate.name: “Live Stream Ended” in api.video, then “Share File With Anyone” in Google Drive
bestTemplate.why: When a broadcast ends, the action makes a Drive file reachable by shareable link at Viewer, Commenter or Editor access.

watchOut: “New Video Created” in api.video is polling, so the Drive step runs on a schedule, not instantly.
